shortDescription: Returns installed software products or fixes as facts.

options.name: all_updates
options.description: Returns all updates for a fileset (default is to return the most recent level only). Mutually exclusive with I(base_levels_only).

options.name: base_levels_only
options.description: Limits listings to base level filesets (no updates returned). Mutually exclusive with I(all_updates).

options.name: bundle
options.description: Specifies a file or bundle to use as the fileset list source. Mutually exclusive with I(filesets).

options.name: filesets
options.description: Specifies the names of software products. Pattern matching characters, such as C(*) (asterisk) and C(?) (question mark), are valid. Mutually exclusive with I(bundle).

options.name: fix_type
options.description: Specifies the type of fixes. C(all) lists all the fixes installed on the system. C(apar) lists only APAR fixes installed on the system. C(service_pack) (alias C(sp)) lists the fixes installed in the system in service packs. C(technology_level) (alias C(tl)) lists the fixes installed in the system as part of technology levels. Mutually exclusive with fixes.

options.name: fixes
options.description: Specifies the names of the fixes. Mutually exclusive with fix_type.

options.name: reqs
options.description: Returns all requisites for a fileset.
